author: Sesam007
quote: It is wonderful to see a game this polished, a very entertainment one. It brings excitement as well as nostalgia, this kind of games are rare today. Animations are great, the combat is refreshing as you can change it to your liking, the forced introduction of genders and agenda pops now and then but does not break the immersion.   All and all this type of games are no longer seen as profitable for the corporations and we need to support them. 10/10 game of the year
